label: Official IDAES PZ/AFS Carbon Capture
request: Build the official IDAES piperazine advanced-flash-stripper post-combustion CO2 capture process with an intercooled absorber, two rich-solvent bypasses, three heat exchangers, steam heating, flash and stripping, solvent make-up, cooling, and lean-solvent recycle.
scope: Cyclic material and regeneration-energy balance at an assumed capture target; no rate-based column, isotherm, or transient bed solution.
